paper_title: Search for Axion-Like Particles produced in $e^+e^-$ collisions at Belle II
notes: Belle II search for e+e- -> gamma a, a -> gamma gamma in mass range 0.2 < m_a < 9.7 GeV/c^2. Sets 95% CL upper limits on g_agamma at the level of ~1e-3 GeV^-1. This is a collider production search (not a DM haloscope), so no DM density assumed. The exclusion plot (Fig. 5) y-axis is g_agamma, confirming AxionPhoton. Numerical limit values vs mass are provided in supplemental text file not reproduced here; data points listed are approximate representative values (~1e-3 GeV^-1) at the stated ~10^-3 level. Precise mass-dependent curve not extractable from text, so data points are rough placeholders and confidence is reduced accordingly.
